'''Three Plum Blossoms Inn''' is an [[inn]] in [[Falme]]. Before the Seanchan arrived, the word "Watcher" appeared in the name but this was hastily painted out.

[[Nynaeve]], [[Elayne]] and [[Min]] meet [[Bayle Domon]] there to discuss sailing away from Falme when they rescue [[Egwene]] from the ''damane'' quarters.{{ref/book|2|43}}
